species.name: Drakith
species.description: Scaled and formidable, drakith carry an elemental inheritance in their blood. Their natural weapons make even an apparently unarmed drakith a dangerous opponent.

species.name: Dwarf
species.description: Dwarves endure through stubborn conviction and practiced craft. Generations spent in stone halls and deep workings have sharpened their sight and steadied their will.

species.name: Eldretchin
species.description: Eldretchin bear the touch of powers beyond the familiar world. Their unusual gifts often arrive alongside a vulnerability that betrays their otherworldly ancestry.

species.name: Elf
species.description: Elves combine graceful movement with memories and traditions reaching deep into the past. Their affinity for hidden lore can guide them toward scholarship, sorcery, or exploration.

species.name: Gnome
species.description: Gnomes possess resilient bodies and inquisitive minds. They carry fragments of ancient knowledge into workshops, secluded communities, and far-ranging adventures.

species.name: Halfling
species.description: Halflings often survive through quick feet, an easy manner, and remarkable good fortune. Their unassuming presence can conceal a daring traveler or a patient infiltrator.

species.name: Halfogre
species.description: Halfogres possess imposing frames and the strength to make full use of them. Whether gentle or fierce, they are difficult to overlook and harder to stop.

species.name: Halforc
species.description: Halforcs unite considerable strength with adaptable talents. Their inherited ferocity becomes a powerful tool when guided by training and purpose.

species.name: Human
species.description: Humans find many paths to distinction. Adaptable skills and individual ambition carry them into unfamiliar lands, rival traditions, and unlikely alliances.

species.name: Lizardman
species.description: Lizardmen move with a hunter’s economy and withstand harsh conditions. Scales, keen night sight, and natural weapons suit a life close to the wilderness.

species.name: Minotaur
species.description: Minotaurs bring formidable strength and a towering presence to any company. Their horns are both a sign of their heritage and a weapon that cannot easily be taken away.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Orcs are physically powerful and resilient. Their ability to summon fierce bursts of aggression serves hunters, guardians, soldiers, and wanderers alike.

features.name: Agile
features.flavor_text: Your movement is precise and assured.
features.rules_text: Increase Agility by 1 step.

features.name: Greater Agility
features.flavor_text: Practice turns quickness into instinct.
features.rules_text: Increase Agility by 1 step. Requires Agile.

features.name: Uncanny Agility
features.flavor_text: You move with extraordinary fluidity.
features.rules_text: Increase Agility by 2 steps. Requires Greater Agility.

features.name: Wise
features.flavor_text: You notice connections others overlook.
features.rules_text: Increase Intellect by 1 step.

features.name: Great Wisdom
features.flavor_text: Experience lends depth to your judgment.
features.rules_text: Increase Intellect by 1 step. Requires Wise.

features.name: Brilliant
features.flavor_text: Your intellect grasps difficult ideas with exceptional clarity.
features.rules_text: Increase Intellect by 2 steps. Requires Great Wisdom.

features.name: Strong Willed
features.flavor_text: Your convictions resist outside pressure.
features.rules_text: Increase Resolve by 1 step.

features.name: Resolute
features.flavor_text: You hold your course when others falter.
features.rules_text: Increase Resolve by 1 step. Requires Strong Willed.

features.name: Iron Willed
features.flavor_text: Your will is difficult to bend.
features.rules_text: Increase Resolve by 2 steps. Requires Resolute.

features.name: Likable
features.flavor_text: Others find it easy to hear you out.
features.rules_text: Increase Social by 1 step.

features.name: Charming
features.flavor_text: Your manner opens doors and disarms suspicion.
features.rules_text: Increase Social by 1 step. Requires Likable.

features.name: Captivating
features.flavor_text: Your presence can command a room.
features.rules_text: Increase Social by 2 steps. Requires Charming.

features.name: Strong
features.flavor_text: You bring solid muscle to difficult work.
features.rules_text: Increase Strength by 1 step.

features.name: Very Strong
features.flavor_text: Your strength is exceptional even among adventurers.
features.rules_text: Increase Strength by 1 step. Requires Strong.

features.name: Monstrous Strength
features.flavor_text: Your physical power borders on the uncanny.
features.rules_text: Increase Strength by 2 steps. Requires Very Strong.

features.name: Tough
features.flavor_text: Your body withstands hardship.
features.rules_text: Increase Vitality by 1 step.

features.name: Resilient
features.flavor_text: You recover your footing after punishing strain.
features.rules_text: Increase Vitality by 1 step. Requires Tough.

features.name: Iron Hide
features.flavor_text: Your constitution is extraordinarily robust.
features.rules_text: Increase Vitality by 2 steps. Requires Resilient.

features.name: Attribute Focus
features.flavor_text: One aptitude sets you apart.
features.rules_text: Increase one attribute by 1 step, to a maximum of 10\.

features.name: Talented
features.flavor_text: You have cultivated an unusual gift.
features.rules_text: Choose one talent or tactic whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Accursed
features.flavor_text: An old power has left both a gift and a wound in your blood.
features.rules_text: Choose Fire, Storm, or Cold. Gain Uncanny Weakness to that damage type and one additional Primary Feature whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Ancient Knowledge
features.flavor_text: Forgotten mysteries linger at the edge of your thoughts.
features.rules_text: Increase Sorcerous Soul by 2\. This adds capacity, not spells.

features.name: Ancient Lineage
features.flavor_text: Your ancestry carries a spark of supernatural strength.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Sorcerous Power by 1\.

features.name: Bite/Claws
features.flavor_text: Your body bears a hunter’s weapons.
features.rules_text: Your bites and claws use Unarmed and deal normal damage instead of Lesser Attack damage. They still suffer Diminishment against an armed target.

features.name: Brute
features.flavor_text: Your blows leave opponents reeling.
features.rules_text: When a melee hit causes Suffering, it inflicts one additional level, to the normal maximum of two.

features.name: Elemental Resistance
features.flavor_text: One force of nature finds little purchase in your flesh.
features.rules_text: Choose Fire, Storm, or Cold. Gain Uncanny Resistance to that type. This creation choice is permanent.

features.name: Grim Lineage
features.flavor_text: Battle and hard resolve run through your heritage.
features.rules_text: Gain +1 rank in Willpower and Melee.

features.name: Horns
features.flavor_text: A lowered head is warning enough.
features.rules_text: Your horns use Unarmed and deal normal damage instead of Lesser Attack damage. They still suffer Diminishment against an armed target.

features.name: Hulking
features.flavor_text: Your broad frame can absorb a punishing blow.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Wounds by 1\.

features.name: Hunter's Lineage
features.flavor_text: You read the land through the instincts of generations.
features.rules_text: Gain +1 rank in Survival, Nature Lore, and Ranged.

features.name: Lucky
features.flavor_text: Fortune has a habit of leaving you a narrow way out.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Luck by 2\.

features.name: Mountain Bones
features.flavor_text: You bear weight with the steadiness of stone.
features.rules_text: Heavy armor does not make you Slowed. It still makes you Loud. Increase maximum Stamina by 1\.

features.name: Natural Armor
features.flavor_text: Scales, hide, or hardened flesh turn aside glancing blows.
features.rules_text: While wearing no armor, you have a 10% Armor Save. It does not combine with worn armor.

features.name: Nightvision
features.flavor_text: Faint light reveals more to you than it does to most.
features.rules_text: Ignore Diminishment from dim light. This does not let you see in complete darkness.

features.name: Ruthless Lineage
features.flavor_text: A merciless ancestral force answers your call.
features.rules_text: Spend a minor action and 1 Stamina. For 3 rounds, saving throws against your spells and Endurance checks against your melee hits are Diminished.

features.name: Fury
features.flavor_text: Your blood rises and every opening becomes an invitation.
features.rules_text: Spend a minor action and 1 Stamina. For 3 rounds, increase your melee critical range by 10 percentage points.

features.name: Skilled
features.flavor_text: Dedicated practice has made one craft second nature.
features.rules_text: Gain +2 ranks in one nonattack skill.

features.name: Stealthy
features.flavor_text: You instinctively find the quiet path and the concealing shadow.
features.rules_text: Your Stealth checks gain Greater Enhancement.

features.name: Swift Lineage
features.flavor_text: Speed is your inheritance.
features.rules_text: Increase major-action movement by 10 feet and minor-action movement by 5 feet.

features.name: Versatile
features.flavor_text: You have learned to be useful in more than one way.
features.rules_text: Gain +1 rank in each of two different nonattack skills.

features.name: Alert
features.flavor_text: You rarely let danger catch you unprepared.
features.rules_text: Increase your Initiative Bonus by 1\.

features.name: Blood Rage
features.flavor_text: Pain sharpens your urge to strike back.
features.rules_text: While Bleeding or suffering at least one level of Suffering, you may make one additional melee attack on your turn, paying its normal minor action and multiple-attack penalty.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.flavor_text: A timely instinct steers you away from disaster.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Luck by 1\.

features.name: Dark Soul
features.flavor_text: Ordinary terrors have lost their hold on you.
features.rules_text: You are immune to Fear, but not Horror. If Horror is reduced to Fear, the Fear ends immediately.

features.name: Hardy
features.flavor_text: Hard work has made your body resilient.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Wounds by 1\.

features.name: Magus
features.flavor_text: You have learned the first secrets of spellcraft.
features.rules_text: Increase Sorcerous Soul by 2 and learn two tier-0 spells. Choose one order containing either spell; gain access to that order and choose both spells from orders you can access. These two spells use the two new Soul slots.

features.name: Man-at-Arms
features.flavor_text: Formal training has taught you a weapon’s finer uses.
features.rules_text: Learn one Weapon Technique.

features.name: Peaceful
features.flavor_text: You know how to make a brief respite restorative.
features.rules_text: You can benefit from five Minor Rests per rolling 24 hours instead of three.

features.name: Regal
features.flavor_text: You carry yourself with practiced authority.
features.rules_text: Your Social skill checks are Enhanced.

features.name: Rigor
features.flavor_text: Discipline keeps you going when effort begins to tell.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Stamina by 1\.

features.name: Rowdy
features.flavor_text: You can make a weapon out of whatever a brawl provides.
features.rules_text: Improvised weapons use your normal attack skill ranks and deal normal damage instead of Lesser Attack damage.

features.name: Toil
features.flavor_text: Long effort has trained you to endure discomfort.
features.rules_text: Your Endurance checks are Enhanced.

features.name: Wisened
features.flavor_text: Patient observation lends weight to your judgment.
features.rules_text: Your Intellect skill checks are Enhanced.

features.name: Alchemical Venom
features.flavor_text: You coax a dangerous tincture from the materials the land provides.
features.rules_text: With suitable plants or other ingredients, spend 3 hours to make one dose of alchemical venom. Coating one weapon or up to five missiles takes a minor action. The coating lasts 8 hours; each hit that inflicts at least 1 wound has a 25% chance to inflict Poisoned. Roll once per hit. Applying more venom does not increase this chance. The dose loses potency 24 hours after preparation.

features.name: Ancient Secrets
features.flavor_text: Fragments of old teachings open the first gates of magic.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Circle magic and learn up to three Circle spells.

features.name: Armor Master
features.flavor_text: You know how to let good armor receive a blow.
features.rules_text: While armored, add 10 percentage points to your Armor Save.

features.name: Battle Armor
features.flavor_text: You adjust and use your protection with a veteran’s care.
features.rules_text: While armored, add 10 percentage points to your Armor Save. This stacks with Armor Master.

features.name: Celestial Soul
features.flavor_text: A little of your own strength passes through every healing touch.
features.rules_text: When your spell or feature restores Wounds to another creature, you may spend 1 Stamina to restore one additional Wound to one target. Use this once per casting or activation, with no extra action.

features.name: Denizen of the Wild
features.flavor_text: The wilderness teaches you both its dangers and its hidden language.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Nature magic, learn up to two Nature spells, and learn one Weapon Technique.

features.name: Druidic
features.flavor_text: Living creatures recognize something familiar in your presence.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Nature magic and learn up to three Nature spells. Gain one small companion: raven, owl, eagle, monkey, snake, or bat. Use the companion rules.

features.name: Elder Oak
features.flavor_text: Your body takes on the endurance of an ancient tree.
features.rules_text: Your unarmed attacks deal normal damage rather than Lesser Attack damage. Gain Uncanny Resistance to Physical damage.

features.name: Eldritch Corruption
features.flavor_text: Something beyond the ordinary world has rewritten a part of you.
features.rules_text: Gain one of these Secondary Features: Nightvision, Horns, Natural Armor, or Accursed. You must choose a feature you do not already have. Accursed grants its usual Primary Feature and Weakness.

features.name: Eldritch Psi
features.flavor_text: A surge of mental power opens a brief passage to forbidden insight.
features.rules_text: Learn up to three Forbidden spells within your Potential, adding the usual Soul slots. This grants access for learning these selections, but you can cast them only on the turn after you spend Sorcerous Power to empower a Psionic spell. Independent Forbidden access removes this casting restriction for spells it covers.

features.name: Elemental Resistance
features.flavor_text: You turn your affinity toward the force you most expect to face.
features.rules_text: Gain Uncanny Resistance to Fire, Cold, or Storm. Choose when you gain this feature; once per 24 hours, you may use a major action to change the type. This is separate from the fixed creation feature of the same name.

features.name: Elementalist
features.flavor_text: Flame, frost, and tempest become instruments of your will.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Elemental magic and learn up to three Elemental spells.

features.name: Enhanced Lethality
features.flavor_text: An opening is enough for you to find a vital point.
features.rules_text: When the final circumstance modifier to your direct attack is Enhancement or Greater Enhancement, increase its critical range by 10 percentage points.

features.name: Esoteric Way
features.flavor_text: Your discipline turns the unarmed body into a channel for elemental force.
features.rules_text: While unarmored, gain the effects of Brawler, Martial Arts, and Elemental Fist without needing their prerequisites. These temporary grants do not qualify you for other talents. They do remove the unarmed wound penalty. This feature does not grant Elemental Conversion for spells.

features.name: Ethereal
features.flavor_text: For an instant, a blow seems to pass through more than flesh.
features.rules_text: Against a nonmagical hit, make a separate 10% Ethereal Save after Armor and Brace. Success reduces damage by 2 wounds. Spells and attacks dealing Eldritch, Enchanted, Light, or Runic damage ignore this save; other attacks explicitly described as magical also ignore it.

features.name: Fang and Claw
features.flavor_text: You follow a successful strike with a predator’s persistence.
features.rules_text: After you hit a creature, your next direct attack against that same creature gains +10 percentage points to its critical range. The bonus expires at the end of your next turn and is consumed by the attempt, hit or miss. A new hit can renew it; it never stacks with itself.

features.name: Feral
features.flavor_text: Unburdened by heavy protection, you strike with dangerous speed.
features.rules_text: While wearing light armor or no armor, add 10 percentage points to your melee critical range.

features.name: Forbidden Knowledge
features.flavor_text: You have read words that wiser teachers would have burned.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Forbidden magic and learn up to three Forbidden spells.

features.name: Greater Companion
features.flavor_text: A formidable beast accepts you as a trusted companion.
features.rules_text: Gain one direwolf, panther, or bear companion. Use its profile and the companion rules.

features.name: Greater Undead
features.flavor_text: The dead you call are held together by a stronger purpose.
features.rules_text: Undead you summon or raise gain +1 maximum and starting Wound. This does not stack from repeated commands or castings.

features.name: Grim Trophy
features.flavor_text: A token of victory holds a measure of the strength you earned.
features.rules_text: Bind one trophy taken from a meaningful victory during a Full Rest. While carrying it, increase maximum Sorcerous Power and maximum Wounds by 1\. Binding fills those increases once; removing and replacing it does not heal or restore Power. If removed, reduce maxima and clamp current values to the new maxima. Only one trophy can be bound at a time.

features.name: Hardened
features.flavor_text: You brace your body and refuse to yield to pain.
features.rules_text: Spend a minor action and 1 Stamina to gain Uncanny Resistance to Physical damage for 3 rounds.

features.name: Heart of the Wild
features.flavor_text: Life surges through you with the stubborn force of spring growth.
features.rules_text: Spend a minor action and 1 Stamina. Restore 1 Wound at the end of your current turn and at the end of each of your next two turns. The effect does not stack with itself. It continues through Unconsciousness but cannot revive the dead.

features.name: Lorekeeper
features.flavor_text: Your studies reveal the common threads beneath rival traditions.
features.rules_text: Gain access to every order of magic and learn up to three spells from any of them.

features.name: Mobile Dodge
features.flavor_text: You make a moving target of yourself without breaking your rhythm.
features.rules_text: After moving at least 10 feet voluntarily on your turn, direct melee and ranged attacks against you are Diminished until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Mythic Lore
features.flavor_text: You learn to give old sacred stories a living voice.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Mythic magic and learn up to three Mythic spells.

features.name: Necromancer
features.flavor_text: You draw upon the stillness that lingers where life has ended.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Necromancy and learn up to three Necromancy spells. You can cast spells learned through this feature only at night or in a place marked by death, such as a graveyard, battlefield, or crypt. Independent access can remove this restriction for spells it covers.

features.name: Outlaw's Cunning
features.flavor_text: You act while slower opponents are still finding their footing.
features.rules_text: Your direct attacks against a creature with a lower initiative total are Enhanced. Tied totals do not qualify, even if you won the initiative tie-break.

features.name: Priesthood
features.flavor_text: You are initiated into a tradition with powers of its own.
features.rules_text: Choose one order, gain access to it, and learn up to three spells from that order.

features.name: Psionic
features.flavor_text: Thought becomes a force that can touch the world.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Psionic magic and learn up to three Psionic spells.

features.name: Ravager
features.flavor_text: You press an assault with little concern for caution.
features.rules_text: While wearing light armor or no armor, you may make one additional melee attack on your turn, paying the normal minor action and multiple-attack penalty.

features.name: Rebuke
features.flavor_text: Your strike tears at the power shielding your enemy.
features.rules_text: When you inflict at least 1 wound with a melee attack, you may spend 1 Stamina to end one beneficial ongoing magical effect on the target. This takes no extra action and can be used once per hit. It does not destroy magic items or remove permanent innate traits.

features.name: Red Rage
features.flavor_text: Pain feeds a fierce refusal to give ground.
features.rules_text: While you have at least one level of Suffering, add 1 wound to damaging attacks. Apply this before defenses, but only if the attack has positive wound damage before this bonus; it cannot turn a nonwounding Lesser Attack into wound damage.

features.name: Rune Armor
features.flavor_text: Protective signs guide force away from the seams in your armor.
features.rules_text: While armored, Armor Piercing cannot reduce your Armor Save. Sunder, damage, and other effects are not automatically prevented.

features.name: Rune Weapons
features.flavor_text: Ancient signs wake along the weapons you wield.
features.rules_text: Your weapon attacks deal Runic damage instead of Physical. Another damage-type conversion can replace this as normal.

features.name: Shadowmage
features.flavor_text: Darkness gives shape to your workings.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Shadow magic and learn up to three Shadow spells. You may cast those spells only while in dim light or darkness. They count as Empowered without spending Power. Becoming brightly lit after casting does not end an existing effect. Independent access removes the casting restriction for spells it covers, but free empowerment still requires dim light or darkness.

features.name: Shadowstalker
features.flavor_text: You move confidently along the uncertain edge of sight.
features.rules_text: Gain +1 rank in Stealth and Nightvision. While in dim light or darkness, increase your direct-attack critical range by 10 percentage points. If you already have Nightvision, it provides no additional benefit.

features.name: Shamanism
features.flavor_text: You learn the rites by which spirits hear and answer.
features.rules_text: Gain access to the Shamanism order and learn up to three Shamanism spells. The feature is distinct from the skill of the same name.

features.name: Spiritual Aura
features.flavor_text: Your resolve gives nearby companions something steady to hold onto.
features.rules_text: You and allies within 30 feet ignore Diminishment and Greater Diminishment on Willpower checks. Suffering and Broken still apply. The aura operates while you are conscious.

features.name: Spiritwalker
features.flavor_text: You sense the paths taken by those without flesh.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Spirit magic and learn up to three Spirit spells.

features.name: Stonetouch Technique
features.flavor_text: A precisely placed blow arrests the body’s motion.
features.rules_text: While unarmored, after an unarmed hit you may spend 1 Stamina, with no extra action, to force an Endurance save. On failure, the target is Stunned. Its normal start-of-turn saves can end the condition. Use once per hit.

features.name: Tactical Training
features.flavor_text: Practice gives your strength a clear purpose in battle.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Stamina by 1 and learn one tactic whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Toxic Fire
features.flavor_text: Your venom carries an unstable alchemical heat.
features.rules_text: Whenever your Alchemical Venom inflicts Poisoned, it also inflicts Burning. Resolve the two conditions separately.

features.name: Unbridled Power
features.flavor_text: You force your body to pay for a final surge of magic.
features.rules_text: Once per 24 hours, spend a minor action to restore up to 2 Sorcerous Power, no higher than your maximum, and take 2 Eldritch damage. Resolve this as one self-damage event with one Suffering check. Protective saves cannot reduce it. It can Defeat or kill you under the normal rules.

features.name: Warrior of the Temple
features.flavor_text: Your martial oath includes initiation into a magical tradition.
features.rules_text: Gain access to one order of magic and learn up to two level-0 spells from it.

features.name: Weirdblood
features.flavor_text: The changes in your blood bring dangerous understanding.
features.rules_text: Gain access to Forbidden magic and learn up to three Forbidden spells.

features.name: Wild Eyed
features.flavor_text: Once you begin an assault, you find it easier to keep striking.
features.rules_text: Reduce only the multiple-attack penalty by one tier: your second attack has no such penalty, and your third or later attack is Diminished. For save attacks, reduce the corresponding save bonus by one tier. Other penalties are unchanged.

features.name: Wild Frenzy
features.flavor_text: Your beast companion answers your aggression with its own.
features.rules_text: Each beast companion you control may make one additional attack on its turn, paying a minor action and the normal multiple-attack penalty. It still needs a command to take offensive actions.

features.name: Moonsight
features.flavor_text: You have learned to trust the faintest light.
features.rules_text: Gain Nightvision. If you already have it, choose a different eligible talent.

features.name: Foretold
features.flavor_text: A promised future seems reluctant to release you.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Luck by 2\.

features.name: Sorcerous Potency
features.flavor_text: You gather more power before your strength is spent.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Sorcerous Power by 1\.

features.name: Otherworldly Spirit
features.flavor_text: Your spirit can hold another fragment of magical knowledge.
features.rules_text: Increase Sorcerous Soul by 1\. This grants capacity, not an automatically learned spell.

features.name: Combat Training
features.flavor_text: Practice turns a familiar weapon into a dependable tool.
features.rules_text: Gain +1 rank in Melee or Ranged.

features.name: Veteran
features.flavor_text: You have learned to endure the demands of battle.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Wounds and Stamina by 1 each. **Prerequisite:** Combat Training.

features.name: Scarred
features.flavor_text: Old injuries have left you harder to break.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Wounds by 1 and gain +1 rank in Willpower. **Prerequisite:** Veteran.

features.name: Vigor
features.flavor_text: A deep reserve of effort carries you through hardship.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Stamina by 2\.

features.name: Relentless
features.flavor_text: You keep your purpose when exhaustion threatens it.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Stamina by 1 and gain +1 rank in Willpower. **Prerequisite:** Vigor.

features.name: Stoneskull
features.flavor_text: A rattling blow rarely scatters your thoughts for long.
features.rules_text: You are immune to Dazed. Staggered still affects you, but ends when a successful save would reduce it to Dazed.

features.name: Deadly
features.flavor_text: You recognize the difference between a hit and a telling hit.
features.rules_text: Increase your direct-attack critical range by 3 percentage points.

features.name: Flanker
features.flavor_text: You exploit an enemy’s divided attention.
features.rules_text: Your Melee attacks are Enhanced when you and a conscious ally threaten the target from opposite sides. In play without a grid, the GM must confirm the target cannot keep both attackers in front. **Prerequisite:** Prowler.

features.name: Prowler
features.flavor_text: You move carefully and react before danger closes.
features.rules_text: Gain +1 rank in Reflexes and Stealth.

features.name: Arms Mastery
features.flavor_text: You study the subtleties of a chosen weapon.
features.rules_text: Learn one Weapon Technique for one weapon type. **Prerequisite:** Combat Training.

features.name: Point Blank Attack
features.flavor_text: Close pressure does not spoil your shot.
features.rules_text: Ignore Diminishment for ranged attacks at melee range with your mastered weapon. **Prerequisite:** Arms Mastery for that weapon.

features.name: Accuracy
features.flavor_text: You wait for a clean line through a crowded fight.
features.rules_text: With your mastered weapon, ignore Diminishment for firing into melee and the chance of hitting an unintended target. **Prerequisite:** Arms Mastery for that weapon.

features.name: Careful Aim
features.flavor_text: You find the opening in a target’s protection.
features.rules_text: With your mastered weapon, ignore normal cover; treat heavy cover as normal cover. Total cover still prevents targeting. **Prerequisite:** Arms Mastery for that weapon.

features.name: Secondary Attack
features.flavor_text: Repeated practice lets you recover your weapon for another strike.
features.rules_text: You may make one additional attack with your mastered weapon on your turn, paying its normal minor action and multiple-attack penalty. **Prerequisites:** Combat Training, Arms Mastery for that weapon, character level 3\.

features.name: Ternary Attack
features.flavor_text: Your attack sequence extends into a relentless combination.
features.rules_text: You may make one additional attack with your mastered weapon on your turn, paying its normal minor action and multiple-attack penalty. This can combine with Secondary Attack, but grants no extra actions. **Prerequisites:** Combat Training, Arms Mastery for that weapon, character level 7\.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.flavor_text: You shape a familiar working with greater control.
features.rules_text: Learn one Spell Technique. **Prerequisite:** Sorcerous Potency.

features.name: Sorcerous Conversion
features.flavor_text: You turn physical effort into magical force.
features.rules_text: When paying Sorcerous Power for a spell or feature, you may spend Stamina instead, one for one. This does not increase your Power maximum or count as restoring Power.

features.name: Elemental Conversion
features.flavor_text: You understand the kinship between flame, frost, and storm.
features.rules_text: When casting a spell that deals Cold, Fire, or Storm damage, you may change that damage to either of the other two types. This changes damage only, not secondary conditions such as Burning.

features.name: Spellblade
features.flavor_text: Magic flashes through your weapon at the instant of commitment.
features.rules_text: Before a melee attack, spend 1 Sorcerous Power without an extra action. The attack deals +1 wound and its entire damage becomes Enchanted. This is spent even if you miss and can be used once per attack.

features.name: Brawler
features.flavor_text: You know how to make an unarmed blow count.
features.rules_text: Your unarmed attacks deal normal damage rather than Lesser Attack damage. The penalty for attacking an armed target remains.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.flavor_text: Your strikes flow into a practiced combination.
features.rules_text: You may make one additional unarmed attack on your turn, paying the normal minor action and multiple-attack penalty. **Prerequisite:** Brawler.

features.name: Elemental Fist
features.flavor_text: Your blows carry the bite of winter, fire, or thunder.
features.rules_text: For each unarmed attack, choose Physical, Cold, Fire, or Storm damage. **Prerequisites:** Martial Arts and Elemental Conversion.

features.name: Gore
features.flavor_text: You know the lethal angles of your natural weapons.
features.rules_text: Increase your critical range by 5 percentage points when attacking with Bite/Claws or Horns. **Prerequisite:** Bite/Claws or Horns.

features.name: Elder Knowledge
features.flavor_text: Study or revelation opens a new magical tradition to you.
features.rules_text: Gain access to one order of magic. This does not grant spells, Soul capacity, or additional Potential.

features.name: Wild Vigor
features.flavor_text: You can summon a fierce reserve when the fighting begins.
features.rules_text: Increase maximum Stamina by 1\. While you have at least one level of Suffering, your Endurance checks are Enhanced. This talent qualifies you for Frenzy and War Howl.

features.name: Armor Breaker
features.flavor_text: You prepare a blow aimed at a defensive weakness.
features.rules_text: Before your next weapon attack this turn, activate this tactic. That attack gains Armor Piercing. **Prerequisite:** Deadly.

features.name: Brace
features.flavor_text: You set your shield to receive the worst of an incoming blow.
features.rules_text: While wielding a shield, gain a separate 10% Shield Save against damaging hits until the start of your next turn. Roll after Armor; success reduces damage by 2 wounds. **Prerequisite:** Veteran and a wielded shield.

features.name: Charge
features.flavor_text: You close the distance in a sudden rush.
features.rules_text: Move up to 25 feet. Apply Slowed and difficult terrain normally. This movement does not include an attack.

features.name: Cleave
features.flavor_text: Your finishing strike carries into the enemy beside your fallen foe.
features.rules_text: When your melee attack reduces a foe from positive Wounds to 0, choose a different foe within your reach and adjacent to that foe. It makes a Reflexes save or takes damage equal to the original attack’s damage before the first foe’s defenses, of the same type. Resolve its defenses normally. This secondary damage cannot trigger another Cleave. **Prerequisite:** Character level 3\.

features.name: Counter Attack
features.flavor_text: You answer an enemy’s commitment with a strike of your own.
features.rules_text: **Response:** After an enemy within your melee reach resolves an attack against you, make one melee attack against it. You must remain able to act. **Prerequisite:** Combat Training.

features.name: Leadership
features.flavor_text: A firm command gives courage a place to return.
features.rules_text: End Fear on yourself or one ally within 30 feet who can hear you. This does not end Horror. **Prerequisites:** Veteran, character level 5\.

features.name: Disrupting Blow
features.flavor_text: You strike as an enemy gathers the breath and will for magic.
features.rules_text: **Response:** When an enemy within melee reach begins casting, attack before the spell resolves. If you inflict at least 1 wound, the spell fails; its action and declared resources are spent. Otherwise it resolves normally. **Prerequisite:** Veteran.

features.name: Execute
features.flavor_text: You turn a telling strike into a decisive one.
features.rules_text: When you critically hit, add 1 wound to the attack before defenses. **Prerequisite:** Deadly.

features.name: Frenzy
features.flavor_text: You throw yourself into a sustained flurry of violence.
features.rules_text: For 3 rounds, you may make one additional melee attack on each of your turns, paying the normal minor action and multiple-attack penalty. **Prerequisite:** Wild Vigor.

features.name: Guarding Blow
features.flavor_text: Your strike forces an enemy to recover before pressing the attack.
features.rules_text: On a hit, force a Reflexes save. On failure, the target’s next attack before the end of its next turn is Diminished. **Prerequisite:** Veteran.

features.name: Knock Down
features.flavor_text: You turn force and timing against your opponent’s footing.
features.rules_text: On a melee hit, force an Athletics save. On failure, the target falls Prone.

features.name: Order
features.flavor_text: Your command calls for immediate, decisive action.
features.rules_text: Choose an ally within 30 feet who can hear you. Immediately after your current action resolves, it takes one major action, with no minor or free actions granted. This is not a new turn: it does not reset attack counts, saves, durations, or resources. A creature can benefit from Order only once per round. **Prerequisites:** Leadership, character level 7\.

features.name: Pin Down
features.flavor_text: You punish the first step of an enemy’s retreat.
features.rules_text: **Response:** When an enemy within melee reach begins voluntary movement, attack before it leaves its space. If you inflict at least 1 wound, its movement ends and it cannot move voluntarily again this turn. **Prerequisite:** Veteran.

features.name: Push Back
features.flavor_text: You drive an opponent away with a forceful impact.
features.rules_text: On a melee hit, force an Athletics save. On failure, push the target up to 10 feet directly away. A solid obstacle ends the push. This is forced movement and does not trigger Pin Down.

features.name: Resurgence
features.flavor_text: You draw on hard-earned endurance to stay in the fight.
features.rules_text: Restore 1 Wound to yourself, up to your maximum. **Prerequisites:** Scarred, character level 3\.

features.name: Shadow Kick
features.flavor_text: You answer an opening with a swift unarmed counter.
features.rules_text: **Response:** After an enemy within unarmed reach resolves an attack against you, make one unarmed attack against it. You must remain able to act. **Prerequisite:** Martial Arts.

features.name: Shield Bash
features.flavor_text: Your protection becomes a blunt weapon for a moment.
features.rules_text: Make one additional melee attack using your wielded shield and Melee skill. It is a Lesser Attack and uses the normal multiple-attack penalty. The tactic’s minor action pays for this attack. **Prerequisite:** A wielded shield.

features.name: Storm Fist
features.flavor_text: Your hands move with the repeated force of a gathering storm.
features.rules_text: For 3 rounds, you may make one additional unarmed attack on each turn, paying the normal minor action and multiple-attack penalty. This does not change its damage type. **Prerequisite:** Martial Arts.

features.name: Sunder
features.flavor_text: You damage the protection rather than merely the wearer.
features.rules_text: On a hit with an Armor Piercing weapon, reduce the target’s worn armor base save to 10% if higher. This happens after the triggering hit; other armor bonuses still apply. Repeated uses do not reduce the base further. Repair takes 1 hour, appropriate tools, materials worth one-quarter of the armor’s listed price, and a successful Craft check. A failed check can be retried with another hour, without consuming additional materials. Natural Armor is unaffected. **Prerequisites:** Arms Mastery and an attack with Armor Piercing.

features.name: Sweep
features.flavor_text: You use a long weapon to take an enemy’s legs from under it.
features.rules_text: On a hit with a two-handed melee weapon, force a Reflexes save. On failure, the target falls Prone. **Prerequisite:** A two-handed melee weapon.

features.name: War Howl
features.flavor_text: Your voice carries the promise of violence.
features.rules_text: Choose one enemy within 30 feet that can hear you. It makes a Willpower save or suffers Fear of you for 3 rounds, with normal start-of-turn saves. **Prerequisite:** Wild Vigor.

features.name: Wind
features.flavor_text: A punishing strike steals the breath needed for the next effort.
features.rules_text: On a melee hit, force an additional Endurance save. On failure, the target loses 1 Stamina, to a minimum of 0\. This is separate from its Suffering check.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.description: You served a shrine or temple, tending its rites and the needs of its people.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte-Knight
backgrounds.description: You trained to defend a religious community with both conviction and steel.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte-Sorcerer
backgrounds.description: You studied the places where sacred tradition and arcane practice meet.

backgrounds.name: Adventurer
backgrounds.description: You have already traveled dangerous roads and learned to prepare for the unexpected.

backgrounds.name: Barbarian
backgrounds.description: You grew up where strength, endurance, and knowledge of the land mattered more than formal schooling.

backgrounds.name: Brigand
backgrounds.description: You survived through intimidation, opportunism, and the threat of a drawn blade.

backgrounds.name: Brigand-Archer
backgrounds.description: You learned to watch a road from cover and make the first shot count.

backgrounds.name: Cultist
backgrounds.description: You pursued forbidden truths among people who welcomed dangerous revelations.

backgrounds.name: Cultist Barbarian
backgrounds.description: Your martial traditions were shaped by secret rites and unsettling powers.

backgrounds.name: Escaped Slave
backgrounds.description: You escaped a life of captivity and learned to endure, hide, and seize a chance at freedom.

backgrounds.name: Farmer
backgrounds.description: Long seasons of labor taught you patience, practical strength, and the needs of living things.

backgrounds.name: Fisher
backgrounds.description: You earned your living from the water, reading weather and waiting for the right moment.

backgrounds.name: Healer
backgrounds.description: You tended injuries and illness, learning to distinguish a hopeful sign from a dangerous one.

backgrounds.name: Hermit
backgrounds.description: Years of seclusion gave you time to study the world beyond ordinary distractions.

backgrounds.name: Hermit-Shaman
backgrounds.description: In solitude, you learned to listen to the spirits of the wild.

backgrounds.name: Hermit-Sorcerer
backgrounds.description: Your isolation sheltered arcane studies that might have drawn unwelcome attention elsewhere.

backgrounds.name: Hunter
backgrounds.description: You followed tracks, watched the wind, and learned the habits of your quarry.

backgrounds.name: Mercenary
backgrounds.description: You sold your fighting skill and learned to value reliable equipment and dependable companions.

backgrounds.name: Noble
backgrounds.description: You were raised among privilege, obligation, and the careful language of influence.

backgrounds.name: Sailor
backgrounds.description: You worked aboard ships, sharing hard labor and close quarters with a demanding crew.

backgrounds.name: Sailor-Pirate
backgrounds.description: You lived by quick hands, quick decisions, and the uncertain fortunes of raiding.

backgrounds.name: Scholar
backgrounds.description: You devoted yourself to books, records, and the patient work of understanding.

backgrounds.name: Scholar-Mage
backgrounds.description: Your scholarship led from ordinary texts into the practice of magic.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.description: You learned discipline, formation, and endurance in organized military service.

backgrounds.name: Thief
backgrounds.description: You made a living where locks, shadows, and unattended valuables meet.

backgrounds.name: Thief-Scoundrel
backgrounds.description: You relied as much on a convincing story as on a quiet step.

backgrounds.name: Treasure Hunter
backgrounds.description: You sought valuables in abandoned places and learned to suspect the obvious route.

backgrounds.name: Wanderer
backgrounds.description: You made your home on the road, accepting hardship and hospitality in equal measure.

backgrounds.name: Wandering Mage
backgrounds.description: You carried your magical studies from settlement to settlement, learning wherever you could.

backgrounds.name: Wandering Shaman
backgrounds.description: You journeyed among communities and wild places, honoring the spirits found in each.

backgrounds.name: Witch Hunter
backgrounds.description: You learned to investigate hidden supernatural threats and meet them with steady resolve.

classes.name: Outlander
classes.description: A traveler at home beyond roads and walls, the Outlander combines wilderness knowledge, practical weapon training, and the first mysteries of nature magic.

classes.name: Outlaw
classes.description: The Outlaw survives through timing, nerve, and an eye for an opening. Whether fugitive, rebel, or opportunist, they strike before an enemy can settle into the fight.

classes.name: Adept
classes.description: The Adept disciplines body and spirit until an empty hand becomes a formidable weapon. Their training prizes movement, restraint, and concentrated bursts of supernatural force.
classes.note: At Adept level 6, gain the Rogue role increase: +1 Initiative Bonus and +2 percentage points to your critical range.

classes.name: Heretic
classes.description: The Heretic pursues truths that established traditions forbid. Their power grows through dangerous insight and an increasing willingness to reach beyond safe limits.

classes.name: Priest
classes.description: The Priest serves a sacred tradition, mediating between mortal needs and powers beyond the world. Their conviction can steady companions as surely as their spells.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: The Mage approaches magic through study, practice, and the recovery of lost knowledge. Every new mystery offers another way to reshape the course of an adventure.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: The Druid draws strength from living places and the old relationships between beast, branch, and soil. A companion often walks, flies, or climbs beside them.

classes.name: Marauder
classes.description: The Marauder fights through momentum and aggression, trusting freedom of movement more than heavy protection. A broken enemy line is an invitation to press forward.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: The Warrior masters the demanding craft of battle. Reliable defenses, weapon training, and tactical discipline make them a steady presence when danger closes in.

classes.name: Templar
classes.description: The Templar joins martial discipline to sacred or esoteric purpose. Their training equips them to stand in the front rank and challenge hostile enchantments.

specializations.name: Savage

specializations.name: Necrotic
specializations.description: You study the threshold between life and death, finding power where the dead have left their mark.

specializations.description: Predatory instinct and stubborn vitality guide you through danger.

specializations.name: Battle

specializations.name: Elemental

specializations.name: Ghostsoul

specializations.description: Ancient signs bind power to the weapons and armor you carry.

specializations.description: You form a close bond with a powerful animal, learning to fight as a practiced pair.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.description: At the start of your turn, make an Endurance save. On failure, take 1 Physical damage. This does not cause Suffering, but still calls for the same Endurance result when checking relevant Resistance or Weakness. It can trigger a Death Save.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Vision-dependent checks and attacks have Greater Diminishment. Make a Faith save to end supernatural temporary blindness. Physical darkness uses visibility rules rather than this condition.

conditions.name: Blinded (Permanent)
conditions.description: As Blinded, but no condition save is allowed. Magic explicitly described as restorative can remove it.

conditions.name: Broken
conditions.description: All checks, attacks, and saves suffer −1 tier. Only Long Recovery removes it. See Defeat.

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.description: Make an Endurance save. On failure, take 1 Fire damage, then make the usual damage Endurance check for Suffering and Resistance or Weakness. A major action spent extinguishing flames with water or smothering them ends ordinary Burning.

conditions.name: Chilled or Slowed
conditions.description: Reduce each movement allowance by 5 feet, to a minimum of 0\. Make an Endurance save to end it unless caused by worn equipment or another persistent physical source. Chilled and Slowed do not add their movement penalties together.

conditions.name: Confused
conditions.description: Make a Willpower save. On failure, use available movement to approach the nearest ally by a reasonably safe route, then make one normal attack against that ally if possible. If no ally can be reached or attacked, take no hostile action that turn. The GM resolves ties randomly.

conditions.name: Controlled
conditions.description: Make a Willpower save. On failure, your controller directs your normal actions this turn. Control grants no extra actions and cannot force you to spend Luck. Orders to inflict direct self-harm allow an immediate additional Willpower save before you obey.

conditions.name: Cursed (Minor)
conditions.description: Your skill checks, attacks, and saves are Diminished. Make a Faith save at dawn to end the curse.

conditions.name: Cursed (Greater)
conditions.description: Your skill checks, attacks, and saves have Greater Diminishment. Make a Faith save at dawn to end the curse.

conditions.name: Cursed (Death)
conditions.description: As Greater Curse. Also make a Faith save each hour; on failure, take 1 Eldritch damage, causing Suffering normally. An hourly success prevents that damage but does not end the curse; a successful dawn save ends it.

conditions.name: Dazed
conditions.description: You have one fewer minor action on your turn. Make a Willpower save to end it.

conditions.name: Fear
conditions.description: Your attacks and non-save skill checks are Diminished, and you cannot willingly approach the source of fear. Make a Willpower save to end it.

conditions.name: Fortified
conditions.description: Direct attacks against you are Diminished. Lasts for the source effect’s duration; if none is given, until the start of the grantor’s next turn.

conditions.name: Fragile
conditions.description: You are awake at 0 Wounds. Further positive damage causes Unconsciousness and a Death Save. Healing at least 1 Wound ends this condition.

conditions.name: Frozen
conditions.description: You cannot move or take actions. Make an Endurance save to end it.

conditions.name: Held
conditions.description: You cannot move away from the creature or object holding you. You can otherwise act. Make an Athletics or Reflexes save, your choice, to escape. The holder must maintain physical contact and can release you without an action.

conditions.name: Horror
conditions.description: Your attacks and non-save skill checks have Greater Diminishment. Use your available movement to flee the source by the safest available route. A successful Willpower save reduces Horror to Fear.

conditions.name: Immobile
conditions.description: You cannot move from your position, but can otherwise act. Make an Athletics save to break free when the restraint can physically be broken.

conditions.name: Loud
conditions.description: Your Stealth checks are Diminished. Ends when the source of the noise is removed or silenced.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Make an Endurance save. On failure, take 1 Toxin damage, causing Suffering normally, and become Dazed until the start of your next turn. This poison-derived Dazed ends when Poisoned ends; unrelated Dazed effects follow their own rules.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: Melee attacks against you are Enhanced; ranged attacks against you are Diminished. Standing costs a minor action. You can crawl at half your normal movement. No save ends Prone.

conditions.name: Staggered
conditions.description: You have two fewer minor actions on your turn, to a minimum of 0\. A successful Willpower save reduces Staggered to Dazed.

conditions.name: Stealth (Unknown)
conditions.description: Your next attack against a creature unaware of your presence gains Greater Enhancement. That attack reveals you and ends this condition.

conditions.name: Stealth (Unseen)
conditions.description: Your next attack against a creature that cannot see you gains Enhancement. That attack reveals you and ends this condition.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: You cannot take actions or move voluntarily. Make an Endurance save to end it.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: You are unaware of your surroundings and cannot act or move voluntarily. Unconsciousness from Defeat ends under the recovery rules; other sources specify their own duration or awakening method.

conditions.name: Vexed
conditions.description: Your nonattack skill checks, including saves, are Diminished. Your attacks are unaffected. Make a Willpower save to end it.

conditions.name: Vulnerable
conditions.description: Direct attacks against you are Enhanced. Make an Endurance save to end it.

conditions.name: Vulnerable (Greater)
conditions.description: Direct attacks against you gain Greater Enhancement. Make an Endurance save to end it.
